This demo is a preview of what’s to come when we launch into Early Access on November 3rd. The demo is now available to download directly from our Steam page, for the duration of the October Steam Next Fest.Progress you make in this demo will carry over into Early Access! events.title: 🎊 Loftia is coming to the October Steam Next Fest with a demo!
events.summary: Hi everyone!Loftia will be participating in Steam Next Fest on October 19th, with a limited-time demo that everyone can download and play!!We know how excited everyone is to step into Loftia, and now we’re opening our sky islands a little earlier to give you a small preview of what’s to come when we launch into Early Access on November 3rd!🌱 Demo detailsThe demo will go live just before the Next Fest begins, on October 19th at 1pm EDT, and will remain playable for 1 week until the Next Fest ends

events.title: Loftia Release Date Announcement! 🎉
events.summary: Hi everyone! It’s official: Loftia is coming to Early Access on November 3, 2026, on PC and Mac!! 🎉🎉🎉 This is the moment we’ve been working towards since we first started building Loftia in 2022. Back then, we were just a few people with a big idea: to create an online world where players could find their new home, spend time with friends, and build a brighter future, together. events.summary: Hi everyone! We can’t wait for everyone to experience the world that we’ve been dedicating these last few years to building.
